about: How the timed runs of a lyric line become words and syllables. Android's model (SyllableRuns.kt wordsFromRuns), chosen by the owner on 2026-11-22; vyral-core::lyrics::words must agree, and the desktop groups words with the same join rule. A run is [startMs, endMs, raw text]. Runs touching with no whitespace between join into one word only when some run in the line contains whitespace (or spacing is explicit) and neither touching character is CJK, kana, CJK punctuation, full-width or Thai. A word's syllables are its runs, listed only when there are two or more: [startMs, endMs, startChar, endChar] in UTF-16 units, the first starting at 0 and each ending where the next starts.

cases.name: runs without a space between are syllables of one word
with no spaces anywhere every run is its own word
a whitespace-only run ends the word
a run that starts with a space starts a new word
an end before the start is treated as the start
